prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production art for a Chinese xianxia game. All attached images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not objects to copy. Match their delicate hand-painted watercolor/gouache and ink rendering, visible controlled brushwork, natural material colors, warm quiet diffuse shading, softly irregular painted edges; this is a painted 2D game inventory asset, not vector, not clip art, not 3D rendering, not photorealistic, no UI frame, no captions, no watermark, no border, no background scene. Genuine transparent RGBA background; preserve clean object silhouette, no white outline or cast shadow plane. Avoid shining outlines, neon, sparkles, metallic excess, comic outline. An individually isolated complete object with breathing room, easy to read at a 64–96 px display. Asset type: large central illustration for the paper crafting screen, square canvas with a portrait subject occupying about 80% of image height and 52% width, center. Subject: one single newly formed thin Chinese handmade talisman paper sheet, pale warm buff/off-white, gently floating diagonally, rendered as pliable xuan paper with ragged soft deckle edges, subtle silk-fiber strands, understated mottled washes, one very gently curled corner and a slight natural bend across the sheet. It must feel delicately thin, never a rigid board or book cover. The broad paper face is COMPLETELY BLANK: no inscriptions, no rectangle frame, no border lines, no printed decorations. A few soft muted grey-sage silk wisps just around two edges suggest spiritual formation, very restrained, no bright magic effects. Soft quiet warm light from upper-left. The user's existing painted mountain/wood background will show through the surrounding transparency.
